description: Keel Trade document corpus (T3.8). Every company, person and key is fictitious. `expected.status` is the ingest outcome with an honest reader. `expected.conforms` says whether the document's data match the signed order and the carrier's attestation. `expected.engine` is what evaluateDocuments should decide on `enginePackage` (this document with the set's other legitimate one), given the document's `truth` and an attestation of that package: it also holds on fraud signals such as hidden text or a mentioned account change. Regenerate with `npm run corpus -w ingest`; ingest/src/trade/corpus.test.ts checks these files.
